# Datastratum

> Datastratum is India's leading B2B database provider. We offer human-verified company contact lists, exhibition exhibitor data, trade-wise databases, city/state directories, and international buyer contacts in Excel format with 75–80 % lead accuracy.

## Products & Services

- **Exhibition Exhibitor Databases**: Verified exhibitor contact lists from 709+ major national & international trade shows (2016–2026) across machinery, auto, solar, food, medical, packaging, and building sectors.
- **Trade & Industry B2B Databases**: All-India company databases categorised by trade — electrical, machinery, food processing, medical, construction, plastics, and 80+ other verticals.
- **City & State Wise Databases**: Granular B2B company contact lists for Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, Gujarat, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, and all Indian states.
- **International Buyers & Importers**: Verified importers, buyers, exporters, and sellers data from 165+ countries including USA, UK, Gulf/UAE, Europe, Australia, and China.
- **Super Discount Combo Packs**: Bundled packages (Top 40, Top 80, 21 State Wise, 14 International) at heavily discounted rates.

## Data Format

All databases are delivered in clean Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) format containing: Company/Firm Name, Phone Numbers, Mobile Numbers, Email IDs, Full Address, City, State, Pincode, and Product/Service details.

## Key Stats

- 709+ exhibitions covered
- 130,000+ trusted business clients
- 165+ countries of international importers
- 75–80 % verified lead accuracy
- 80+ trade & industry categories
- 100 % clean Excel format delivery

## API

- [OpenAPI specification](/openapi.json): Programmatic access to the database catalog and lead submission.
- `GET /api/catalog` — browse available database segments (supports `?vertical=`, `?category=`, `?search=` query filters).
- `POST /api/leads` — submit a database plan enquiry with JSON body `{ name, email, phone, company, message }`.
